entities.name: Kiku
entities.description: A woman from the Numai swamps of Kamigawa, skilled warrior and jushi spellcaster who wields purple camellia blooms.

entities.name: Numai
entities.description: The swamps that are Kiku's home.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A man who meets Kiku and later seals her curse in a tile.

entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: A companion forced to join the Hyozan Reckoners with Kiku.

entities.name: Uramon
entities.description: The boss of the Hyozan Reckoners whom Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer turn against.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: A group bound by a hyozan oath and curse; Kiku is forced to join.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: An ogre who fights Kiku and Toshi at Minamo.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: Place where the final fight occurs.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: Spirits against whom the hyozan declared a vendetta.

entities.name: Yuki-onna
entities.description: Spirits who helped kill Kiku's men.

events.summary: Toshiro Umezawa meets Kiku on his trek through Takenuma; she takes him to Uramon.
events.quote: Toshiro Umezawa met Kiku during his trek through Takenuma when going home from a soratami attack.

events.summary: Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer are forced to join the Hyozan Reckoners after the yuki-onna kill her men.
events.quote: Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer were forced to join the Hyozan Reckoners .

events.summary: Soratami shinobi and bushi attack the mahotsukai manor; the elders trigger a revenge curse that turns Kiku into a killing machine and drives her toward insanity.
events.quote: the elders triggered a revenge-magic curse that took hold of Kiku and changed her into a killing machine

events.summary: Toshi finds Kiku, spends the night with her and seals the curse in a ceramic tile.
events.quote: In the morning, she was free of the curse, which Toshi sealed into a ceramic tile for later use.

events.summary: At Minamo, Hidetsugu defeats Kiku bloodlessly; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and the tile breaks, so the curse reclaims her.
events.quote: In the fall, the tile was broken and the curse claimed her again.

events.summary: Toshi stops Kiku from killing Hidetsugu, invoking the hyozan curse on herself, then blinds the ogre.
events.quote: thus invoking the hyozan curse upon herself

events.summary: Toshi sends Kiku through the shadows back to Numai; her fate is unknown.
events.quote: Toshi sent Kiku through the shadows back to Numai.

relations.quote: Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer were forced to join the Hyozan Reckoners .

relations.note: helped him and was helped by him
relations.quote: Toshi promised to help her and she rewarded him by making love with him.
he used Kiku as an example of how to avoid the hyozan oath by defeating her bloodlessly.
